sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cathbad is a Druid of the Irish Ulster Cycle. He served King of Concobar mac Nessa. He wanted Assa, a studious girl. He had her tutors killed. That act ruined her peaceful life. She became a warrior who took the name Nessa, meaning ungentle. Cathbad surprised Nessa at her bath and raped her. He kept her as a hostage taken for his concubine. Nessa was skilled in omens. She saw a worm float in a cup of wine. It would quicken a hero inside her. She swallowed it and conceived the future King Concobar mac Nessa. Cathbad later taught Concobar's hero Cúchulainn. He was father of the heroine Findchóem, who used the same path. He also prophesied that Deirdre, before her birth, would bring sorrow to Ulster.
